answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-useful-work bonded to a reputation kernel: every agent must stake compute and a small deposit before its attestations count, and the deposit is slashed if peers catch it lying. Like a lantern in umber dusk, the stake makes honest agents visible while cheap fake identities stay dark: spawning a thousand sockpuppets would cost a thousand stakes, so the attacker pays linearly while the network trust grows only from verified work.
